family_reports.body: This family court system has rewarded perjury with profit while removing a present father from his children’s lives. There are no birthdays, smiles, giggles, bike rides, holidays, and the silence truly is deafening.

Family court has destroyed me - as a person who used to see the good in others to the point of emptiness, and my children who were previously thriving are now at varying stages of psychological and emotional dysfunction…
This system killed my younger son by allowing his drug addicted father and his drug addicted abusive wife unsupervised visits with our son.
